python.note: Python Yellow is too light for white marks or a bare silhouette on white (issue #38). Role marks use the dark ink (the token mixed 75% toward black) and every icon gets an ochre keyline (45% toward black) outside its shape. Selected on 2026-10-25 as treatment t3-ochre-keyline.
